meta.name: newsletter-monetization-planner
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "monetize my newsletter", "build a sponsorship rate card", or "model paid-subscription revenue"; produces a revenue model (paid tiers, ad/sponsorship inventory + CPM/flat rate card, referral/boost loops), a list-growth ↔ revenue projection, and honest-offer / disclosure checks for the SEND-D lever. Not for scoring the whole program or running D1 — use email-quality-auditor; not for the return math — use roi-calculator; not for the post-click page — use landing-optimizer. 邮件newsletter变现/赞助刊例/付费订阅测算

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划邮件通讯的变现方案与收入模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你运营邮件通讯并想设计付费订阅或广告收入模式。
copy.tagline_en: Plan monetization strategies and revenue models for your newsletter.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run a newsletter and want to design paid tiers or ad revenue models.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你提供的订阅人数、打开率等数据，帮你规划邮件列表的三种赚钱方式：付费订阅、广告赞助和推荐增长。它会生成一个收入模型、增长与收入预测，以及广告披露和诚信检查清单。
howto.when: 当你要求“为我的邮件列表变现”、“制定赞助刊例”或“测算付费订阅收入”时触发。需要你提供订阅人数、打开率等基础数据。

say.text: 帮我为2万订阅者的邮件列表规划变现方案，包括付费订阅和赞助。
say.note: Claude 会要求你提供打开率等数据，然后生成收入模型。

howto.what_en: Claude plans revenue for a newsletter or creator list across paid subscriptions, ad/sponsorship inventory, and referral loops. It produces a revenue model, a list-growth-to-revenue projection, and a disclosure checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to monetize a newsletter, build a sponsorship rate card, or model paid-subscription revenue. Requires list size and open/click rates.

say_en.text: Plan monetization for my 20,000-subscriber newsletter, including paid tiers and sponsorships.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for open rates and then generate a revenue model.

say_en.text: Build a sponsorship rate card and paid-sub revenue model for a 45K list at 42% open / 3.1% click.
say_en.note: Claude will compare paid-sub-only vs hybrid and output detailed projections.
